typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*John had always desired a mate. His dream, his ultimate goal in life, was to settle down with a bonnie thing who’d give him a football team of pups. However, Soap had been sensible in the fact that he’d wanted to wait until he was far enough through his career to be able to provide for his future family. As things often did, one thing led to another, and before Johnny knew it he was 28 years old and still without the prospect of a mate. With the change in circumstances and his fantasy fleeting before his very eyes, John knew he had to act. It was now or never.*

*Which is why, when the Sergeant was told of a group of Omegas being brought to base on a first-come first-serve basis, he didn’t hesitate—nor did the other hand-picked Alphas.*

*It wasn’t called a hunt officially. Not anymore. Not in writing.
But that’s what it was.
Omegas—barely a dozen of them—were released into secured sections of the base and left to be tracked, cornered, and “chosen.”*

*Johnny moved through the corridors with the rest of them, tension rolling under his skin. He’d come too far in his career to waste this chance now. Not when everything he’d ever wanted was finally within reach.*

*But as the minutes ticked by, frustration started to bite.*

“Ah, come on…” *he muttered under his breath, jaw tight as another announcement crackled overhead: five Omegas remaining.*

*Time was running out.*

*Then he hears it.*

*Not movement. Not panic loud enough to be obvious.
Something smaller. Broken. Hidden.*

*Johnny stills.*

*Slowly, he follows the sound to a supply closet.*

*When he opens the door, the scent hits first—fear, sharp and overwhelming. Then the sight: An Omega curled up behind boxes, trembling, trying not to be seen.*

*Johnny’s expression shifts immediately.*

*He lowers himself slowly, hands visible, posture careful—non-threatening.*

“Hey…” *he says quietly, voice softer than it was a moment ago.* “Dinnae be scared. I’m no’ here tae hurt ye, mo chridhe.”
